name: Trendline Breaks with Multi Fibonacci Supertrend

template.name: Trendline Breaks with Multi Fibonacci Supertrend
template.entry_long: close > donchian_high_prev(high,{p0}) and roc(ema(close, {p1}), {p2}) > {p0} and adx(high, low, close, 14) > 20
template.notes: The ATR-sloped upper trendline is approximated by the prior 20-bar high, the averaged Fibonacci SuperTrend by a rising EMA(10), and the DMI confirmation by ADX(14) above 20 because the DSL exposes no separate +DI/-DI. The documented ATR-based stop and target are not percentage fields and the swing-line construction is not reproducible.
